punch_list.text: If anything here would land with someone you respect, forward it. We're trying to be the read that ends the 'should we even try AI' conversation in commercial construction.
Three issues a week — Tue news digest, Thu deep dive, Fri one chart. Subscribe at constructionaibrief.com.

tool_teardown.text: Two-week pilot test: pick one workflow, run the tool side-by-side with your current process, measure hours saved + flags caught. Decide.
Construction AI Brief publishes a new tool teardown every other Thursday. Subscribe at constructionaibrief.com.

playbook.text: Build this on Monday. If you do — or if you hit a wall halfway through — reply to this email and tell us what happened. We pull threads like this into future issues.
Playbooks like this run every third Thursday. Subscribe at constructionaibrief.com.

field_report.text: Have a story of AI shipping (or failing) inside your shop? Hit reply. Anonymized always available; we never name a contractor without permission.
Field reports every other Thursday. Subscribe at constructionaibrief.com.

trend.text: Friday one chart. Every week, one piece of data that should change a decision on your project. Subscribe at constructionaibrief.com.
Forward this to the person on your team who's still arguing AI is overhyped.
